in_marathi.name: Mahindra
in_marathi.long_meaning: Mahindra हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Mahindra is derived from the Sanskrit words 'mah' meaning great and 'indra' meaning lord. This name is associated with the Hindu god Indra, the king of the gods and the god of rain and thunder.

in_bengali.name: Mahindra
in_bengali.meaning: হিন্দু নাম যার অর্থ Mighty, Powerful
in_bengali.long_meaning: Mahindra একটি হিন্দু নাম যা ভারতীয় সংস্কৃতিতে গভীর আধ্যাত্মিক তাৎপর্য রাখে। Mahindra is derived from the Sanskrit words 'mah' meaning great and 'indra' meaning lord. This name is associated with the Hindu god Indra, the king of the gods and the god of rain and thunder.
